'''Ariq Melvar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] who served in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Melvar was posted aboard the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']] and shortly after the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], Melvar was part of a group of ''Executor'' crewmen who were tasked with investigating the [[Death/Legends|murder]] of [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Tanith Sorn]].
